title: Can the Macrogeometry of Dental Implants Influence Guided Bone Regeneration in Buccal Bone Defects? Histomorphometric and Biomechanical Analysis in Beagle Dogs
authors: Fernández-Domínguez M, Ortega -Asensio V, Fuentes -Numancia E, Aragoneses JM, Barbu HM5, Ramírez-Fernández MP, Delgado-Ruiz RA, Calvo-Guirado JL, Samet N, Gehrke SA. J Clin Med. 2019 May 7;8(5):618. doi: 10.3390/jcm8050618.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss maxresorb / maxresorb inject (biphasic CaP) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The apical portion of the implant, with a stronger self -tapping feature, may provide better initial stability, even in the presence of a bone defect in the buccal area” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
